product_name_specific: SL-Class, Mercedes-AMG SL 55 4MATIC+, Mercedes-AMG SL 63 4MATIC+, SL 43
risk_description: The roof frame panel above the windscreen might be insufficiently attached to the vehicle and could become detached from the vehicle in motion, creating a risk of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
